slice: The owner's decisions of 2026-10-10 on #222: the bow becomes legacy's solid stem (x 14..16) and bow-visor opening (x 16..22), entered from above, with the main deck, its underside and the overhead from x 22 (replacing #238's 27); and the engine block becomes solid, a departure from legacy recorded in docs/decisions.md
command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run license-check && npm run sites:check && npm run devcontainer:check && npm run build && npm run dist:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:parity && npm run pixi:visual-check && npm run interior:check && npx playwright test
workingTree: clean before the run and still clean after it (git status --porcelain empty at both ends)
timestampProvenance: Both are date -u output printed around the run. The whole chain ran under the shared e2e port lock, taken before START and released after END.
provenanceNote: Branch feat/222-bow-visor-engine from main e2a59ce (#226). The change is 2876b2b alone; the commit after it adds this file. The full run above is on 2876b2b; later commits only update this file.

results.sitesCheck: pass: site resources match src/sites.js (4 sites)
results.distCheck: pass: 16 files scanned, no source maps, 4 diagnostic markers absent
results.unit: 568 passed in 49 files (+6 over main e2a59ce, counted from the changed test files: tests/unit/wreck-route.test.ts 13 -> 18, tests/unit/game-controller-buoyancy.test.ts route block 5 -> 6)
results.parity: 332 passed (none added; no parity checkpoint reads the route)
results.e2e: 173 passed in 10.1 min, first run, no retries (none added; tests/hud-readouts.spec.js's rule-of-thirds test now enters the hold through the bow visor's opening)
results.pixiVisualCheck: 3 scenes ok, 0% changed pixels, against the win32 frames re-recorded in 2876b2b

oracle.bow: src/sites.js: the bow stem is solid at x 14..16, dTop 28 (line 322); the main deck is a structure from x 22 to 78 at d 27..28 (line 327), after the bow-visor opening (comment, line 326); the visor is a bowVisor feature at (18, 26) (line 449), drawn by src/renderer.js drawBowVisor (line 5806) as a 72 by 20 px slab (3.6 by 1 m at 0.05 m/px), hinged up. src/renderer.js drawWreckEntryMarkers marks the BOW entry from above at x 16..22 on the main-deck line (line 4962). overheadAt (src/sites.js line 977) is true when a structure with its bottom above the diver spans its x: from x 22 under the deck, never in the opening at the vehicle-deck depth. Legacy's zone map (visualZones, src/sites.js line 560) puts the vehicle deck, an interior zone, at x 14..170, d 28..40, so it disagrees with overheadAt in the opening.
oracle.engine: src/sites.js lines 503..508: the engines are site features ({kind:'engine'}), not structures; solidAt, solidBoxAt and solidOverlapArea iterate only s.structures, so legacy's diver swims through its engines. The migration client departs from that by the owner's decision, recorded in docs/decisions.md (Deliberate departures).

implemented: src/sites/wreck-route.ts: the deck's underside starts at x 22 with the deck (was 27); CARGO_HOLD_FROM_M 27 -> 22; WRECK_HOLD_BOW_X_M 21 -> 16, the stem's after face; WRECK_STEM_TOP_M 24.5, level with the deck's underside as legacy's stem top is with its deck's; routeSpacesAt ahead of the deck: open water to 34 m before x 14, water to the stem's top over x 14..16, water to the hold's floor (33.5 m) in the opening x 16..22, all outside the overhead; WRECK_VISOR, the raised visor standing on the deck's forward edge (x 22..23, from 19.4 m to the deck), solid; WRECK_ENGINE and engineTopAt, the cylinder and its bed setting the floor under the deck. The Pixi renderer and the dev canvas adapter draw the hull and the hold from the shared WRECK_HULL_EDGE and WRECK_HOLD_EDGE, stroked as open paths so no line closes the opening; the engine from WRECK_ENGINE; the guideline over the stem, down the opening and over the engine. src/app/game-controller.ts is unchanged.
gameplayEffect: The dive still starts at route position 10, open water from the surface to 34 m. A diver level below 24.5 m off the bow is stopped by the stem; the hold is entered by crossing the stem above 24.5 m, sinking in the opening and swimming aft under the deck from x 22, where the overhead, the rule of thirds and the Cargo hold readout begin. In the opening the HUD reads Wreck exterior, following legacy's overheadAt rather than its zone map. The engine block stops the diver, who goes over its top at 27.4 m.

referenceFrames.command: npm run pixi:visual-update (win32), on the working tree that became 2876b2b
referenceFrames.changedScenes: all three: wreck-exterior-start, wreck-descended and wreck-torch-off. Each shows the bow, where the sloped bow is replaced by the stem, the opening and the raised visor, the hold's forward wall moves from the slope to x 16, and the guideline now runs over the stem and down the opening.
referenceFrames.note: The first recording captured wreck-exterior-start as a uniform frame (meanLuma 21.683, sdLuma 0); the recorder refuses only uniformly black frames, so it was accepted. It was recorded again before the commit (meanLuma 42.706, sdLuma 31.688), and the committed frames were checked by eye. The linux frames (manifest blob 4f76a248d96757f427506dd4125d4889576b24cc) are main's and still show the old bow; they are left to the linux workflow.

counterChecks.method: Each mutation was applied on 2876b2b to a file copied from a backup taken just before it, and checked; the file was then restored from the backup and its sha256 compared with the one taken before the mutation (all equal), and git status was clean at the end. The unit mutations are checked with tests/unit/wreck-route.test.ts, src/render/renderer.test.ts and tests/unit/game-controller-buoyancy.test.ts (40 tests); the browser ones under the shared e2e lock.

The rooms the scene draws in the hold (full-height bulkheads at x 43 and 73, a partial one at 97, platforms at 48..67 and 79..93) are still passable, as before this change. Making them solid would split the hold into compartments; left for the owner.
The provisional drawing has no main hatch (legacy x 78..92) and no superstructure, so the overhead agrees with legacy's overheadAt only from 8 to 78 m along the hold's depth.
